title: Meetings & Events Sales Limits: Attendance Range, Booking Window, Option Period and Menu Deadline
content:
Each Meetings & Events package is sold for a set attendance range and booking horizon, holds its proposal open for a set option period, and sets how far ahead of the event the menus are confirmed. All periods are in calendar days.

| Package | Fewest attendees sold | Most attendees sold | Most calendar days between contracting and the event | Option period after the proposal (calendar days) | Menus confirmed at least this many calendar days before the event |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 6 | 16 | 365 | 7 | 14 |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 10 | 80 | 365 | 7 | 14 |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 10 | 120 | 365 | 10 | 14 |
| Social Reception Package | 30 | 250 | 540 | 14 | 21 |
| Wedding Celebration Package | 50 | 300 | 730 | 14 | 30 |
| Conference Plenary Package | 100 | 1200 | 1825 | 30 | 30 |

## Reading the limits

- The attendance range is inclusive at both ends: the Executive Boardroom Package is sold for 6 attendees and for 16, but not for 5 or 17.
- Ranges overlap; an expected attendance of 60, for instance, falls within the Half-Day Meeting, Full-Day Meeting, Social Reception and Wedding Celebration ranges.
- The Conference Plenary Package can be contracted furthest ahead, up to 1825 calendar days, and holds its option longest, 30 calendar days.
- The Wedding Celebration and Conference Plenary packages have the earliest menu deadline, 30 calendar days before the event.

## Hypothetical illustration

For a Full-Day Meeting Package proposal, the option period is 10 calendar days and the menus are confirmed no later than 14 calendar days before the event.
